Job Title: Cybersecurity Analyst
Responsibilities: Analyze security logs, manage vulnerabilities, and automate script workflows.

ranked_candidates.raw_text:
ADITYA KULKARNI
+91 96650 28174 | aditya.kulkarni@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/adityakulkarni-sec | tryhackme.com/p/aditya0xk | Pune, Maharashtra
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Final-year B.Tech Computer Science (Cybersecurity specialisation) student at Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune with hands-on experience in penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and network security analysis. Ranked in the top 2% on TryHackMe globally and completed a security internship conducting VAPT assessments on live client environments. Adept at offensive and defensive security tooling with a strong foundation in networking protocols and exploit development. Seeking a Cybersecurity Internship to contribute to red team or SOC operations in a professional security environment.
EDUCATION
B.Tech — Computer Science & Engineering (Cybersecurity Specialisation) 2022 – 2026 (Expected)
Symbiosis Institute of Technology, Pune CGPA: 8.6 / 10.0
Relevant Coursework: Network Security, Cryptography, Ethical Hacking, Digital Forensics, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Reverse Engineering, Secure Coding Practices
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Offensive Security: Metasploit, Burp Suite Pro, Nmap, Nikto, SQLMap, Gobuster, Hydra, John the Ripper, Netcat
Defensive & Forensics: Wireshark, Snort, Splunk (basic), Autopsy, Volatility, OSSEC, UFW, Fail2Ban
Languages & Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell (basic), SQL
Platforms & Standards: Kali Linux, Parrot OS, Windows AD (lab), OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, CVE/CVSS, VirtualBox
EXPERIENCE
Cybersecurity Intern — Kratikal Tech Pvt. Ltd., Noida (Remote) May 2025 – Jul 2025
Conducted web application VAPT on 3 client environments under senior supervision, identifying 14 vulnerabilities including 2 critical-severity issues (IDOR and stored XSS) using Burp Suite and manual testing aligned with OWASP Top 10.
Performed network reconnaissance and internal port scanning using Nmap NSE scripts on a simulated enterprise LAN; documented findings in CVSS-scored vulnerability reports delivered to clients.
Automated a Python script to parse Nmap XML output and generate formatted HTML summary reports, reducing manual report compilation time from approximately 2 hours to 18 minutes per assessment.
PROJECTS
Home Lab Active Directory Attack & Defence Simulation | Windows Server, Kali Linux, Splunk Jan 2025 – Mar 2025
Built a virtualised 3-machine Active Directory lab (Windows Server 2019 DC + 2 Windows 10 clients) to simulate and detect common AD attack chains including AS-REP Roasting, Pass-the-Hash, and Kerberoasting using Impacket and CrackMapExec.
Deployed Splunk Free on the domain controller and wrote 6 custom detection rules alerting on suspicious LDAP queries, failed Kerberos pre-auth events, and lateral movement indicators, achieving zero false positives across 4 test runs.
Documented the full kill chain with screenshots and mitigations in a 22-page technical report; shared on GitHub where it received 47 stars from security students.
Web Application Penetration Testing — DVWA & Juice Shop | Burp Suite, SQLMap, Python Aug 2024 – Oct 2024
Systematically exploited all 10 OWASP vulnerability categories across DVWA (all security levels) and OWASP Juice Shop, documenting attack vectors, payloads, and remediation guidance for each finding.
Chained a reflected XSS vulnerability with a CSRF token bypass to achieve stored session hijacking on DVWA medium security — a multi-step exploit not covered in standard walkthroughs.
Published a structured methodology write-up on Medium covering the full testing approach; article received 2,900+ views and was shared in 3 cybersecurity Discord communities.
Network Traffic Analyser & Anomaly Detector | Python, Scapy, Wireshark, Pandas Mar 2024 – May 2024
Built a Python tool using Scapy to capture and parse live packet data, extract protocol distribution, top talkers, and flag port scan patterns (SYN flood detection via threshold-based heuristics).
Validated detection logic by replaying 4 publicly available PCAP files from the Wireshark sample captures repository, correctly identifying scan activity in all 4 cases with no false positives.
Exported parsed session data to Pandas DataFrames for time-series visualisation; tool processes approximately 8,000 packets per second on a mid-range laptop.
CERTIFICATIONS
eJPT — eLearnSecurity Junior Penetration Tester (INE Security) Completed: Jan 2025
Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate — Coursera (8 courses) Completed: Aug 2024
ACHIEVEMENTS
Top 2% globally on TryHackMe (handle: aditya0xk) — completed 180+ rooms including Advent of Cyber 2024 (all 24 days) and earned 14 pathway completion badges across OWASP, Pre-Security, and SOC Level 1 paths.
1st place, CyberQuest CTF 2024 (SIT Pune inter-college event, 38 teams) — solved 11 of 12 challenges across web exploitation, forensics, and cryptography categories within 8 hours.
Responsible disclosure: reported a reflected XSS vulnerability in a Maharashtra state government portal via CERT-In; acknowledged and patched within 3 weeks (disclosure timeline maintained).
EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
President, CyberSec Club, SIT Pune — organised a 2-day annual event CipherStorm 2025 featuring a CTF, two guest talks, and a hands-on Burp Suite workshop attended by 190 students from 5 colleges.
Regular CTF competitor (team: 0xSIT) on PicoCTF, HackTheBox, and CTFtime-listed events; team ranked 34th nationally in PicoCTF 2024 (1,800+ Indian teams).
Writes technical CVE breakdowns and HTB machine walkthroughs on a personal blog; 6 posts published, 3,100+ total views, with one post featured in a weekly cybersecurity newsletter.
